database.pollingEstimate: Source-traced 2026-11-05: each successful PrismaRoomStore.getRoom call performs one Prisma Client participant.findFirst with relationLoadStrategy=join. Prisma counts each Prisma Client query as one operation regardless of internal SQL count. At the configured 30-second interval this is 172,800 room-poll operations/month for two continuously open tabs and 345,600 for four. A two-hour guest match uses about 480 room-poll operations for two players or 960 for four, before setup/actions/reconnects. Each visible signed-in account with presence opted in sends one heartbeat every 30 seconds; each calls one updateMany, adding about 120 operations per opted-in account per two-hour session.
database.note: Owner approved dedicated Production database on Prisma Free ($0, fixed 200,000-operation shared workspace cap; no paid upgrade or overages). Direct Console plan and $0 invoice were last confirmed 5 November; current billing cannot be refreshed through CLI. At 07:10 UTC Prisma CLI measured 10,611 Production operations. The sum across all nine databases in all five enumerated projects is 36,383 at 07:10 UTC, a derived estimate rather than the direct Console workspace meter. The Production backup inventory at 07:12 UTC showed no listed backups (zero retention). Production database is ready and lists five credential records, but per-credential health is unavailable. One manual dump/restore drill passed once; Free has no automatic backups, and recurring backup/restore ownership and cadence remain open.
database.workspacePollingHeadroomAtObservation: At the 2026-11-06 07:10 UTC derived workspace estimate of 36,383/200,000, about 163,617 operations remained. Based only on one operation per successful room poll, this equates to about 340 two-hour two-player or 170 four-player sessions before other queries. Two tabs polling continuously every 30 seconds add an estimated 172,800 operations per 30-day month; four tabs add 345,600. These remain estimates, not measured capacity acceptance.
